text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This paper is a meta-analysis review study synthesizing existing research on agricultural land conversion and ecosystem services loss globally. It is not a primary research paper focused on land use land cover (LULC) future prediction or simulation at national scale with spatial modeling outputs. The study does not implement or compare future LULC scenarios, nor does it produce mapped LULC projections. Its primary focus is on quantifying ecosystem service losses associated with agricultural land conversion through meta-regression analysis of past studies, not on LULC prediction modeling. Therefore, it does not meet the core inclusion criteria for LULC prediction research and is excluded.)
